comment: services/visualization/vscode_monitor/syntaxes/traceflow-log-arrows.tmLanguage.json: in a .log file (VS Code's Log language, text.log), an epoch block's value (a token with a digit) followed by ▲ (better than the epoch before) is traceflow.better.log, one followed by ▼ (worse) traceflow.worse.log, the arrows too; .vscode/settings.json (editor.tokenColorCustomizations) colours them green and red. The file stays plain text (utils/logger.py writes no colour code into it).
